messages:
Lina: pic drop  Ember (our office corgi mix) discovered the leftover bubble wrap and is now conducting a full boop / pop audit. https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T00000-F22222/ember_bubble.jpg :dog: :bubble:

Marcus: OMG the little bonk face. did she pop it or gently boop? :joy:

Lina: gentle bonk at first, then a suspiciously coordinated stomp. I think shes inventing a percussion routine. uploaded a 7s clip.

Juno: must protect bubble wrap rights. also pls check for static cling—Ember now has a sticky note stuck to her ear that says "HR". :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

FacilitiesBot: Heads up: bubble wrap is office supply; please dispose in recycling bin after use. 

Marcus: poll time  Should we keep a small stash of bubble wrap for Ember's percussion therapy? 1) Yes - designated pop corner 2) No - recycle after unboxing 3) Tiny stash only for calm days

Juno: `/:one:` yes for percussion therapy

Lina: `/:three:` tiny stash, and only under supervision (no chewing)

Marcus: `/:two:` recycle, I am a bubble wrap realist

PollBot: Poll created: "Bubble wrap for Ember?" Options: Yes - designated pop corner / No - recycle after unboxing / Tiny stash only for calm days  Current: Yes 1, No 1, Tiny stash 1

Juno: also Ember performed a dramatic slow-flop onto the pile and then a full-body wiggle. certified morale booster. :sparkles:

FacilitiesBot: Note: if kept, please store bubble wrap away from vents and heat sources. Facilities will provide a small bin if requested.

Lina: offering a tiny training update: taught her "pop" (hand signal) and she responds with a single soft nosh. training video incoming. :clap:

Marcus: motion to add "Ember Pop Corner" to the office map. filing request with Ops. :map:

Juno: bringing a lint roller and an extra sticky note for Ember's HR duties. :roll_of_paper:

Lina: thanks team! will post the training vid and one more candid where she tries to herd the popped bubbles. great start to the week. :heart:
